route_note: High-speed ferries run from Shekou to Jiuzhou or Hengqin, or take a coach across the Pearl River Delta via the Humen Bridge.
High-speed trains run frequently from Shenzhen North or Futian station to Guangzhou South, about 30-40 minutes, then metro into the city.
Intercity trains and the Dongguan–Huizhou intercity line connect Shenzhen North and Futian to Dongguan stations in under an hour.
